name: Bow
soul: The soul of someone who bends and does not break; who holds a tension a long time and lets it go all at once.
spark: The mote stretches thin between two points when you hold your breath, and snaps back when you let it go.

hybrid.text: It waits, bent, for the one moment, and then it is somewhere else.

newFeatures.label: fletching of the field along its limbs
a string that hums when something is about to matter

settled.name: Child's bow
settled.text: A bent stick and a string, the kind every yard has. It has decided to be a real one and is practising its hum.
settled.sign: A bent stick, and a string that is never quite slack.
settled.habit: It hums one note, experimentally, and stops when you look.

paths.name: Hunting Bow
paths.of: one who is most themselves where no one is watching
paths.text: It learned from you that the shot is the last and smallest part of a hunt.
paths.sign: Its limbs are scuffed with bark, and it smells of outdoors.
paths.habit: It leans toward any open door or window.

prongs.name: Stalker's Bow
prongs.of: one who learned young to cross a house without being heard
prongs.text: It makes no sound it does not mean to, and has begun to expect the same of you.
prongs.sign: Its string is wrapped where it would otherwise slap.
prongs.habit: It goes quiet when you do. It goes quiet a little before you do.

finishes.name: The Held Breath
finishes.of: one who can stay at full draw for as long as it takes
finishes.text: At full draw the field goes still round it, and you with it, for as long as you can stand.
finishes.sign: At rest it is still slightly drawn. It has been for a year.
finishes.habit: The room goes a little stiller when it is in it. Clocks seem to notice.

finishes.name: Lone String
finishes.of: one who does their best work with no one to see it
finishes.text: It has only ever been drawn by one hand, at night, with no one to see the shot. It likes that.
finishes.sign: A dark limb and a dark string, and the eye in its grip is closed.
finishes.habit: It leaves by itself at night, and is back on its hook by morning with its string damp.

prongs.name: Tracker's Bow
prongs.of: one who remembers everything they ever followed
prongs.text: An arrow that has hit a thing remembers it. The bow keeps the arrows.
prongs.sign: Old arrows bound along its back, each with a different fletching.
prongs.habit: It turns, slowly, to keep pointing at something that left hours ago.

finishes.name: Blood-trail
finishes.of: one who cannot leave a trail half followed
finishes.text: Its next arrow knows the way the last one's quarry went. You follow the bow now.
finishes.sign: Its grip has an ear of its own, pressed toward the ground.
finishes.habit: It pulls at your hand on any path where something has passed.

finishes.name: Bowyer's Pride
finishes.of: one who is made of everywhere they have been
finishes.text: It has remade itself limb by limb on the long hunts, out of what the hunts gave it. There is horn in it now.
finishes.sign: Horn at the tips and sinew on the back, none of it bought.
finishes.habit: It looks over anything dead for what could be used, and is respectful about it.

prongs.name: Fowler's Bow
prongs.of: one who takes their chance on the wing
prongs.text: It learned to take things out of the air, and then to do it while you ran.
prongs.sign: Light limbs, and small vanes at the tips that turn in a breeze.
prongs.habit: It follows birds across the sky from wherever it is hung.

finishes.name: Wing-shot
finishes.text: It looses while you are still moving. It prefers it; you have stopped planting your feet.
finishes.sign: It is never still on its hook. It sways as if walking.
finishes.habit: It looses a thread of light at falling leaves, and catches most.

finishes.name: Skyline
finishes.of: one who notices whatever stands above the rest
finishes.text: Anything that shows against the sky inside its reach is already falling.
finishes.sign: Its arrow of light points up and a little out, always, at the horizon.
finishes.habit: It sits facing the highest edge in view: a roof, a ridge, a wall.

paths.name: War Bow
paths.of: one who looks after people from behind them, and would rather not be thanked
paths.text: It learned from you that an arrow is a way of being beside someone you cannot reach.
paths.sign: A heavy bow with broad shoulders, hung where it can see the whole room.
paths.habit: It keeps to the back of any gathering, facing the front.

prongs.name: Volley-bow
prongs.of: one who gives everything at once, to everyone
prongs.text: It has stopped choosing a target and started choosing a piece of ground.
prongs.sign: A fan of small bright fletchings along its upper limb.
prongs.habit: On fine evenings it looses a handful of sparks straight up, for the look of it.

finishes.name: Arrow-storm
finishes.of: one who has been saving it up
finishes.text: On your chain's last beat it empties itself into the air. What comes down is the payout.
finishes.sign: Its string trembles for a long time after anyone has touched it.
finishes.habit: It holds very still all day, and you can feel it counting.

finishes.name: Fire-arrow
finishes.of: one who leaves a mark where they stood
finishes.text: Your element rides the shaft. Where the arrow stands, the ground is yours for a while.
finishes.sign: The arrow of light on its string is the colour of your element.
finishes.habit: It plants small lights in the ground round camp and watches them burn down.

prongs.name: Line-bow
prongs.of: one who keeps pace with what is following
prongs.text: It shoots from the tender, down the rail, at the dark that is keeping pace.
prongs.sign: Flat feet on its lower limb, set to brace against a moving floor.
prongs.habit: It faces backward on any road, watching where you have been.

finishes.name: Tender's Bow
finishes.of: one who brings everyone home and counts their arrows after
finishes.text: It has brought every passenger in with the same full quiver it left with, give or take what was needed.
finishes.sign: A small lamp at the grip, and a quiver that always looks full.
finishes.habit: It counts its arrows at each stop. It counts the passengers too.

finishes.name: Wire-song
finishes.of: one who can hear when something along the line has gone wrong
finishes.text: Its string hums in tune with the line's wires. A dark post makes it flat, and it tells you which one.
finishes.sign: Its string hums with the line's wires, a fifth above.
finishes.habit: It hums along to anything strung tight: fences, washing lines, a fiddle.

prongs.name: Covering Bow
prongs.of: one whose friends have learned to trust what passes their ear
prongs.text: It shoots past friends. They have had to learn to trust it and mostly have.
prongs.sign: An eye in the riser that looks at your friends' backs, never their faces.
prongs.habit: It turns to whichever classmate has just left the room, and stays turned.

finishes.name: Over-the-shoulder
finishes.of: one who helps from so close it is almost rude
finishes.text: Its arrows go by a classmate's ear on the way to what was behind them. None of them flinch now.
finishes.sign: It hangs just behind your shoulder, and a little behind your friends' too.
finishes.habit: It reads over people's shoulders. It means well.

finishes.name: Pin-shot
finishes.of: one who stops a quarrel by holding somebody's sleeve
finishes.text: An arrow through the hem, the sleeve, the shadow. Whatever comes at you arrives late and annoyed.
finishes.sign: Thin bright threads trail from its arrows, like sewing.
finishes.habit: It pins things that are about to blow away: a map, a hat, a letter.

paths.name: Singing Bow
paths.of: one who feels a thing coming before it has a name
paths.text: It learned from you that a drawn string is a note, and that notes can be used.
paths.sign: Its string sounds, faintly, when nothing has touched it.
paths.habit: It hums before visitors arrive. A different note for each one.

prongs.name: Humming-bow
prongs.of: one whose quiet makes others quiet
prongs.text: It holds a draw without an arrow and lets the string speak. Things nearby slow to listen.
prongs.sign: A soft ring of light round the middle of the string.
prongs.habit: It holds one low note while you work. You work better.

finishes.name: Snare-string
finishes.of: one whose patience is a trap
finishes.text: The note it holds is a snare. What walks into the sound finds its feet have opinions.
finishes.sign: Fine roots of light trail from its lower limb into the ground.
finishes.habit: It hums at mice until they sit down.

finishes.name: Vigil-note
finishes.of: one who can keep the same watch from dusk to light
finishes.text: One low note, held from dusk to light. Nothing has come inside the sound.
finishes.sign: A steady glow in the string that does not flicker all night.
finishes.habit: At dusk it starts one note, and you only notice when it stops at dawn.

prongs.name: Omen-bow
prongs.of: one who flinches before the blow and has learned to trust the flinch
prongs.text: Its string moves before things happen. You have learned which movements mean what.
prongs.sign: The eye in its grip is old, and looks a little past you.
prongs.habit: Its string twitches at nothing. Later, something happens.

finishes.name: The Twitch
finishes.of: one whose nerves are quicker than their thoughts
finishes.text: The string twitches a breath before the strike. You guard on it without looking any more.
finishes.sign: A string that is never quite still.
finishes.habit: It startles at shadows, and is right about one in three.

finishes.name: Far-seer's Bow
finishes.of: one who knows where the heart of a place is before going in
finishes.text: Loosed straight up at the mouth of a deep run, its arrow comes down where the heart of the place is.
finishes.sign: An eye at each tip as well as the grip, and the three do not agree.
finishes.habit: At any threshold it looses one thread of light straight up and watches where it falls.

prongs.name: Oath-bow
prongs.of: one held together by a gift they mean to deserve
prongs.text: It is strung with something given, not made, and it shoots straighter for the giver.
prongs.sign: Its string is not gut or wire. It looks like a hair, or a thread from a sleeve.
prongs.habit: It will not be strung by anyone else. It goes slack in their hands.

finishes.name: Unstrung
finishes.of: one who no longer needs what used to hold them together
finishes.text: It looses without a string now. The oath does the pulling.
finishes.sign: No string at all. The limbs are bent anyway.
finishes.habit: It draws and looses nothing, slowly, like someone going over an old conversation.

finishes.name: Mourning Bow
finishes.of: one who shoots where someone else would have
finishes.text: A shade strung it. It shoots where they would have, and they were better than you.
finishes.sign: A dark wrap on the upper limb that it has never let you change.
finishes.habit: On certain evenings it stands by the hearth, strung, and aims at a place by the door.
